_comment: The tsconfig strictness layer, merge into the target repo's compilerOptions (or extends). Flags beyond strict:true per the Total TypeScript cheat sheet. Deliberately WITHOUT noUnusedLocals/noImplicitReturns, unused variables belong to ESLint (autofix and _-prefix exceptions). verbatimModuleSyntax requires an ESM module setting: under module=commonjs it emits TS1287/TS1295 about the module system itself; back it out as debt, do not change the repo's module system to satisfy it.
